lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. This is an emergency now. Heavy bleeding getting worse and being “really out of it” after birth can be life-threatening. Call nine one one right now, or go straight into the ER entrance if she’s with you. Stay with her, keep her awake, and do not leave her alone. If you can, tell staff she is two weeks postpartum with heavier bleeding and mental health safety concerns.
originalTexts: Thank you for telling me. This is an emergency now. Heavy bleeding getting worse and being “really out of it” after birth can be life-threatening. Call **911** right now, or go straight into the ER entrance if she’s with you. Stay with her, keep her awake, and do not leave her alone. If you can, tell staff she is two weeks postpartum with heavier bleeding and mental health safety concerns.
